verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe custom Types as blueprints for Objects, per-Object Properties (e.g., auto-populated from bookmarks), and Queries that let users define criteria to assemble Views for retrieval — directly matching typed properties used for organization/retrieval [anytype-docs-32][anytype-docs-38][anytype-docs-46][anytype-docs-53][anytype-docs-8][anytype-docs-21]. Community evidence corroborates database/table usage for structured organization [anytype-comm-4][anytype-comm-10]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated 'tag' property type and independent hands-on evidence of consistent tag-based retrieval at scale (one community note flags a lack of merge/dedup tooling as databases grow [anytype-comm-10]).
